visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a wide shot of the Milan Cathedral under a clear blue sky with white clouds; numerous pigeons are scattered across the stone pavement of the plaza. (2) A unique perspective from below a glass dome shows five young women and one man peering down into the camera, smiling and gesturing. (3) A woman with long dark hair, wearing sunglasses and a blue cardigan over a white patterned dress, speaks to the camera while standing in the crowded plaza. (4) Close-up shots capture the intricate marble facade of the cathedral, featuring statues and the text 'MARIAE NASCENTI' above a central window. (5) The woman squats down in the plaza, pointing toward a large flock of grey pigeons on the ground while many tourists move in the background. (6) A series of shots on the cathedral rooftop reveals numerous white marble spires and statues; a golden statue of the Virgin Mary (Madonnina) stands atop the highest central spire. (7) Wide shots from the rooftop show the surrounding Milan city skyline and various architectural elements of the cathedral under bright daylight. (8) Construction scaffolding is visible around several spires and statues, indicating ongoing renovation work. (9) The woman and a male companion in a cream-colored shirt walk together on the rooftop, admiring the stone forest of statues and embracing at the end.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 米蘭大教堂的3個都市傳說. [Logo]: lovemiihuang. (2) [Variety]: 第3個直接被我破解了?. (3) [Subtitle]: 嗨我是小米，這是在義大利的第二天. (4) [Subtitle]: 來朝聖最經典的米蘭大教堂. (5) [Subtitle]: 你們有看到大教堂下面超多鴿子. (6) [Subtitle]: 都市傳說1，廣場的鴿子不怕人. (7) [Subtitle]: 當地人有個說法是因為鴿子代表聖母的使者. (8) [Subtitle]: 餵鴿子也是祈福的行為唷. (9) [Subtitle]: 逛到大教堂頂樓露台時發現教堂尖塔上有一尊「金色聖母像」. (10) [Subtitle]: 這就是都市傳說2，聖母永遠是米蘭最高點. (11) [Subtitle]: 所以米蘭建新大樓時，都會在頂樓放一尊小型聖母像，不然...會帶來厄運. (12) [Subtitle]: 正當我們細細品味教堂白色粉紅大理石建築，讚嘆它是哥德風建築的極致時. (13) [Variety]: 欸! 發現很多地方都在整修. [Variety]: 整修*1. (14) [Variety]: 整修*2. (15) [Subtitle]: 第3個都市傳說就是米蘭大教堂永遠蓋不完. [Variety]: 整修*3. (16) [Subtitle]: 從1386年開始到1965年才勉強完工. [Variety]: 整修*4. (17) [Subtitle]: 因此流傳「只要還沒完工，米蘭就會一直繁榮下去」. [Variety]: 整修*5. (18) [Variety]: (所以都市傳說就是一個浪漫的故事). (19) [Subtitle]: 不過我還是非常推薦買含露台的大教堂門票. (20) [Variety]: (不想爬樓梯記得買電梯版). (21) [Subtitle]: 數不完的雕像，親自感受石雕森林的震撼. (22) [Subtitle]: 也能好好欣賞米蘭市景，非常值得.
